title: Abrams ComicArts' Kana Licenses Tsubonari's Antengai: Twilight Metropolis Manga
content: Abrams ComicArts ' Kana imprint announced on Monday that it has licensed Tsubonari 's Antengai: Twilight Metropolis ( Antengai Gensō Kiroku ) manga, and will begin releasing the manga in spring 2027.
author: ANN

title: Voice Actor Tom Kane Dies
content: Kane had suffered a stroke in November 2020, which damaged his ability to speak or write. He retired from voice acting after his stroke. Kane voiced Professor Utonium and HIM in The Powerpuff Girls animated series, though he did not voice the characters in the anime.
author: ANN

title: Inklore Reveals English Print Cover for 1st Volume of Eleceed Webtoon
content: Inklore has revealed the first English-language print cover for global webtoon hit ELECEED , marking another step in the series' expansion beyond digital platforms, along with its upcoming anime adaptation . Publisher Inklore will release ELECEED , Vol.
author: ANN

title: Manga UP! Global Adds Repeated Vice: I Refuse to Be Important Enough to Die Manga
content: Manga UP! Global launched in English on Wednesday the Repeated Vice: I Refuse to Be Important Enough to Die ( Repeat Vice: Akuyaku Kizoku wa Shinitakunai node Shitennō ni Naru no wo Yamemashita ) manga by Hiromi Taihei , author Hitsugi Kurokawa , and character designers Kuki Kushiro and daichi .
author: ANN

title: WEBTOON Ent. Narrows Losses in 1st Quarter 2026
content: WEBTOON Entertainment narrowed its losses in the first quarter of 2026, posting an operating loss of US$8.03 million — down from US$26.63 million in the same period a year earlier, a roughly 70% improvement. The company disclosed the results on May 11.
author: ANN

title: Nintendo Announces New Photo-Based Smartphone Game Pictonico!
content: Nintendo announced on Monday a new smartphone game titled Pictonico! , which will launch on May 28. The company streamed a trailer: The game is a free-to-start game that uses photos taken on players' phones to insert real people's faces into minigames.

title: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Reveals First Look at New Blu-ray Release
content: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle is gearing up for its highly anticipated home video launch in Japan later this Summer, and a new preview has shown off a much closer look at the release.

title: 2 Years Later, Major Crunchyroll Isekai Confirms Season 3 Release Date With New Look
content: A major Isekai anime franchise is returning to Crunchyroll this Summer with a whole new season of episodes, and has confirmed the release date for Season 3 of the anime with a new look teasing more of what to expect.
